page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processor based on x86_64 architecture, this instance features 16 physical CPU cores with hyper-threading enabled to deliver 32 dedicated vCPUs. It is configured with 128 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The processor cache configuration consists of 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. Hardware instruction set support includes AVX-512, AES cryptography, and FMA. The instance lacks local NVMe SSD storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.g5.8xlarge demonstrates average multi-core efficiency paired with weaker single-threaded throughput. Single-core performance metrics, such as a stress-ng single-core score of 1107.99 and a Geekbench single-core score of 995.0, place in the bottom 25% of evaluated systems. Conversely, parallel execution achieves middle-tier results, highlighted by a stress-ng multi-core score of 23637.07, a PassMark CPU score of 23223.67, and a Geekbench multi-core score of 8902.0. Uncached large-block memory bandwidth tests recorded 96.24 GB/sec for reads and 48.07 GB/sec for writes.

Application benchmarks reflect its multi-core resource allocation, showing 22.63 million operations per second in Redis SET performance, 17.15 GB/sec in static web serving throughput, and 8652.42 in PassMark database operations. Small-model LLM prompt processing reached 1425.71 tokens per second on a 135M model and 39.14 tokens per second on a 7B model. Given its core density and standard memory footprint, the instance offers a practical hardware profile for multi-threaded backend applications, web servers, container hosts, and in-memory caching nodes where maximum single-core clock speed is not critical.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz and 128 GB of RAM. Built on x86_64 architecture under the KVM hypervisor, it provides 16 physical cores with hyper-threading, 35 MB L3 cache, and support for AVX-512 extensions. The instance relies on external block storage and offers a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Performance testing indicates average multi-core processing and memory bandwidth capacities, demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core score of 23637.07, a PassMark CPU score of 23223.67, and Redis throughput of 22.63 million SET operations per second. Single-core throughput is in the bottom quartile, highlighting a trade-off between parallel efficiency and individual core speed. With 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, this instance is suitable for web serving, database operations, and multi-threaded backend applications.
